title: fonderie.download: filter pills each set in their own font
note: The fonts-in-use page filters a 4-column grid of posters and books by typeface. The filter is a row of outlined pills with 30px+ radius, and each pill's label is set in the font it filters, so the buttons double as a specimen; the active one fills black with white text. Work images sit edge to edge in grey boxes with a 22px gap. Worth reusing: labelling a filter, tag or nav item in the thing it points to (a font, a colour, a material) instead of plain text.
